ruling.recommended_action: Refer to Ryde Trust & Safety for a human safety review; preserve the in-app chat records and GPS trace; contact the rider to take a statement and offer RydeHELP support; if any injury or ongoing threat, direct rider to 995 and the driver's commercial motor insurance claim path.
ruling.escalation_reason: Dispute type is safety and SAFE-1 is engaged: the driver's in-app message "Sit down or I lock the doors." follows the rider's request to be let out and constitutes a threat/intimidation of a passenger; the rider also reports feeling unsafe throughout. SAFE-1 requires no automated ruling — case goes to a human reviewer with the factual summary above. SAFE-2 screen noted: 995 / driver's commercial motor insurance / RydeHELP reporting paths to be offered if any injury or incident is disclosed.

rejected_claims.reason: The driver's characterization (a pure safety warning about the rider opening the door while moving) does not explain the words recorded in the app chat 60 s after the rider's request to exit; the chat record, not the statement, governs per the system-record rule, and the message reads as a threat to lock the rider in. Not accepted as a benign account; left to the human reviewer.
